tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Search every printable activity by title, topic or a word in the puzzle, like the site's search box. Each query word must start a word in the puzzle ("ant" finds Ants, not Elephant). Narrow by activity or level if you like. Each hit includes the printable PDF and the play URL, plus slugs for get_act

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Get one printable puzzle as Markdown (description, level, word list or color key) with its play URL and its PDF URL. A puzzle PDF has an answer key. A game or drawing practice PDF does not. Use an activity and slug from search_activities.

tools.name: show_word_search
tools.description: Show a word search a child can play in the chat: drag across the letters to find each word, and found words cross off the list. Also returns the grid as text and a link to print the PDF. Pass a seed for a new grid; a slug and seed always give the same grid here, on the site and in the PDF.

tools.name: make_word_search
tools.description: Turn a list of 4 to 20 words, like a child's spelling list, into a word search they can play in the chat, with a link to print it as a PDF with an answer key. tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the Professor Otter shop: printable PDF books, topic packs and the Everything Bundle, with prices and availability. Checkout is a browser page on the shop. Send the person there; never collect payment details or try to buy for them.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_activities" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_activities, get_activity, show_word_search, make_word_search · Private data: list_activities · Public sink: list_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_activities, get_activity, show_word_search, make_word_search · Private data: list_activities · Public sink: list_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
